samples.content:
<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    Half() : match(0), value(0) {}
    Half(ll m, ll v) : match(m), value(v) {}
    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

vector<vector<ll>> ways;

bool nextCombination(vector<int>& a, int n) {
    int k = a.size();
    int ptr = k - 1;
    while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
        ptr--;
    }
    if (ptr < 0) return false;
    a[ptr]++;
    for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
        a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
    }
    return true;
}

ll getWins(const char* s, int r, int c) {
    int curA = 0, curB = 0;
    ll ret = 0;
    int len = 2 * (r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'A') {
            curA++;
        } else {
            ret += ways[curB][r - 1] * ways[curA][r];
            curB++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

ll slow(int r, int c, const string& s) {
    int total = 2 * (r + c);
    vector<int> as(r);
    for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) as[i] = i;
    ll totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];
    vector<char> buf(total);
    ll bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
    ll ans = 0;
    vector<string> good;
    do {
        fill(buf.begin(), buf.end(), 'B');
        for (int pos : as) buf[pos] = 'A';
        int match = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                match = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        ll winsA = getWins(buf.data(), r, c);
        ll diff = abs(2 * winsA - totalWays);
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            good.clear();
            if (match) good.push_back(string(buf.begin(), buf.end()));
            ans = match;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += match;
            if (match) good.push_back(string(buf.begin(), buf.end()));
        }
    } while (nextCombination(as, total));
    return ans;
}

ll bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
ll ans = 0;
ll totalWays;

void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
    ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
    ll diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
    ll delta = a.match * b.match;
    if (diff < bestDiff) {
        bestDiff = diff;
        ans = delta;
    } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
        ans += delta;
    }
}

vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
    sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
    int sz = 1;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        if (arr[i].value == arr[sz - 1].value) {
            arr[sz - 1].match += arr[i].match;
        } else {
            arr[sz++] = arr[i];
        }
    }
    arr.resize(sz);
    return arr;
}

inline bool test(int mask, int i) {
    return (mask >> i) & 1;
}

int trailingZeros(int x) {
    // returns number of trailing zeros, for x != 0 works; for x==0 returns 32
    if (x == 0) return 32;
    return __builtin_ctz(x);
}

ll solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
    bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
    ans = 0;
    ll maskA = 0, maskB = 0;
    int len = s.length();
    vector<vector<int>> cnt(len + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        cnt[i + 1][0] = cnt[i][0];
        cnt[i + 1][1] = cnt[i][1];
        if (s[i] == 'A') {
            cnt[i + 1][0]++;
            maskA |= (1LL << i);
        }
        if (s[i] == 'B') {
            cnt[i + 1][1]++;
            maskB |= (1LL << i);
        }
    }
    ll lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
    ll lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);
    
    vector<vector<Half>> fst(c + 2), snd(c + 2);
    vector<int> sz(c + 2, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < c + 2; i++) {
        sz[i] = (int) ways[c + 1][i];
        fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
        snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
    }
    
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); mask++) {
        int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
        int idx = --sz[btc];
        // first half
        {
            int samePref = (mask & 1) == 0 ? trailingZeros(mask) : trailingZeros(mask + 1);
            if (samePref > c + 1) samePref = c + 1; // mask can be 0, leading zeros up to c+1?
            int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
            int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];
            if ((mask & 1) == 0) totalA += samePref;
            else totalB += samePref;
            ll winsA = 0;
            int curA = 0, curB = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                if (test(mask, i)) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * ways[r - 1 + curA][r];
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }
            int exactMatch = 1;
            for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; i++) {
                if (!test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') { exactMatch = 0; break; }
                if (test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A') { exactMatch = 0; break; }
            }
            fst[btc][idx] = Half(ways[totalA + totalB][totalA] * exactMatch, winsA);
        }
        // second half
        {
            int match = 1;
            if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
            if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;
            ll winsA = 0;
            int curA = btc, curB = compBtc;
            for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                if (test(mask, i)) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * ways[r - 1 + curA][r];
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }
            snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
        }
    }
    
    totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
    ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
        vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
        vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);
        int ptr = (int) two.size() - 1;
        for (const Half& a : one) {
            while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) ptr--;
            if (ptr >= 0) update(a, two[ptr]);
            if (ptr + 1 < (int) two.size()) update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

void preCalc() {
    ways.resize(61);
    for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
        ways[i].resize(i + 1);
        ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
}

// I/O utilities
string nextToken() {
    static string line;
    static istringstream iss;
    while (true) {
        if (!iss) {
            if (!getline(cin, line)) return "";
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        if (iss >> token) return token;
    }
}

int nextInt() {
    return stoi(nextToken());
}

void submit() {
    int r = nextInt();
    int c = nextInt();
    string s = nextToken();
    cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    preCalc();
    submit();
    return 0;
}
